about.purpose: Time-aware political state of every traced territory. Each entry starts at an event (never at a frame), so the control timeline moves with the campaign timeline if events are re-placed. Entries with fromEvent null hold from the first frame.

roles.BELLIGERENT: A principal party to the war at this point.
roles.CO_BELLIGERENT: Fights alongside a principal party, or is attacked by one, without being a principal.
roles.CONTRIBUTOR: Contributes named individuals or a small element to one side; not a party at war.
roles.UNINVOLVED: No recorded part in the campaign. Drawn as inactive territory.
roles.ARMISTICE: Hostilities suspended or ended by a recorded political act.

status.CONTROLLED: Held by its own government. The war never transferred ownership of any traced national territory: imperial forces operated inside Jura and at Dwargon's eastern gate but occupied no national region, which is shown with operational areas instead.
status.UNKNOWN: Control is not established by the record. Never drawn as a faction colour.

about.provenance: CANONICAL entries restate an event the canon audit supports. INFERRED entries follow from several recorded events. Every entry names its basis.

T-EMP.basis: Before the mobilization order the Empire is not yet at war.
Combat ends when Michael and Feldway withdraw (EVT-0386). There was no imperial armistice proposal: Benimaru demanded unconditional surrender, which the Empire accepts at the summit (EVT-0392).

T-JTF.basis: No war footing recorded before the Control Room order of battle.
Tempest confirms its four-corps order of battle against the coming invasion (EVT-0004).
Combat ends with the withdrawal of Michael and Feldway (EVT-0386).

T-DWG.basis: Dwargon is not attacked before the blockade of its eastern gate.
The Empire blockades Dwargon's eastern gate (EVT-0016); the allied division of tasks follows (EVT-0018).
Fighting on the Dwargon front ends when the clowns are withdrawn (EVT-0385) and combat ends with the withdrawal (EVT-0386).

T-EUR.basis: No Eurazanian participation recorded before the eastern-front reinforcement.
Phobio arrives on the Dwargon eastern front with the Kurenai advance force (EVT-0350).

defaultForUnlisted.basis: The dataset records no part in the campaign for this territory.
